summary: Subscription Priority Bug Fix Verified - All 15 backend tests pass. The critical bug where entitlement returned 'trial_expired' instead of 'status_active' when an org has both expired trial AND active paid subscription is FIXED.

entitlement_priority_logic.details: GET /api/billing/entitlement correctly prioritizes active non-trial subscriptions over expired trials. When org has both expired trial AND active paid subscription, returns is_entitled=true with reason='status_active'

admin_org_list_priority.details: GET /api/admin/organizations correctly shows subscription_status='active' and is_trial=false when org has both expired trial and active paid subscription

trial_active_entitlement.details: When only active trial exists, entitlement correctly returns is_entitled=true, reason='trial_active', with trial_days_remaining

paid_active_entitlement.details: When only active paid subscription exists, entitlement correctly returns is_entitled=true, reason='status_active'

webhook_endpoint.details: POST /api/webhook/stripe endpoint exists and returns proper error for invalid signature (not 404)

bug_reproduction_test.details: Direct MongoDB test: Inserted expired trial + active paid subscription for same org, verified entitlement returns is_entitled=true, reason='status_active' (not 'trial_expired')

critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly implemented: server.py lines 4342-4360 now use find().to_list(10) instead of find_one(), with priority logic to prefer active non-trial subscriptions
Admin org list (lines 2554-2565) has same priority logic applied
Checkout webhook (lines 4839-4851) correctly cleans up old trial subscriptions when real subscription is created
All three fix locations verified working correctly

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 tests passed - 10 API tests + 5 MongoDB tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Admin dashboard and demo user dashboard verified working)

seed_data_creation: MongoDB tests create temporary test subscriptions (sub_test_expired_trial_*, sub_test_active_paid_*) and clean them up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscription priority bug fix verified. Demo org (org_demo_0725dd5e668a - Riverside Football Academy) currently has active trial with 13 days remaining. The fix ensures that when a user subscribes via Stripe after trial, the active paid subscription takes precedence over any expired trial subscription documents.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: When a user subscribes via Stripe after a trial, the checkout.session.completed webhook creates a NEW subscription document (matched by subscription_id, not org_id). The old trial subscription document remains with is_trial=True and an expired trial_end_date. The entitlement check used find_one() which could return the old trial doc first, resulting in 'trial_expired' even though the user has an active paid subscription.
fix_applied: 1. Entitlement check (server.py ~line 4342): Changed from find_one to find().to_list(10), with priority logic to prefer active non-trial subscriptions over trial ones
2. Checkout webhook (server.py ~line 4839): Added cleanup that sets is_trial=False on old trial subscriptions when a real subscription is created for the same org
3. Admin org list (server.py ~line 2554): Same priority logic as entitlement check
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Direct MongoDB test inserted both expired trial and active paid subscription for same org, verified entitlement correctly returns is_entitled=true with reason='status_active'
